notes.title: Gamepad control Update + XBox controller support added
notes.content:
Pals, here is new update!

[list]
[*] Gamepad control fixed. Now you dont need to move analog stick maximally left or right to walk. Just a little. Controls become much comfortable.
[*] XBox controller support now is avalible
[/list]
